Before this change render.go wrote `---` before a top-level typed block; stored version markdown of that shape now reads (ParseRendering, the browser's VersionView) as a rule and a paragraph holding the fences. Consumers: docs/rebuild.go:89, approval_carry.go:406/450, edit_notices.go:287, api/write_advice.go:277. Needs a backfill of stored rows or evidence none exist.
The PR adds a refusal at the API boundary (400 INVALID_MARKDOWN for a typed block inside 32) and carries no `## Contract change census`.

A third reading change is undocumented: a link reference definition inside a `:::` block now defines a reference for text before the block (`[r]

:::callout{}
[r]: https://u.example
:::
`); the comment and CHANGELOG say two readings differ.

The 1,000 ms heartbeat window starts at navigation, so it measures bundle load and first render as well as the parse; the implementer measured 748 ms on the iphone project. The browser suite runs in CI (envoy-and-contracts.yaml:974), so this is a flake risk on a required check.

The MIT-licensed factory copies sit inside a legion-owned file; the package's convention is a file boundary between copied and legion-owned code. Also `?? 0` at :601 hides a broken invariant rather than failing.
